# Paris Heating & Cooling

> Paris Heating & Cooling is a local HVAC company serving Paris, Brant/Haldimand-Norfolk, Ontario, offering furnace repair, AC repair, ductless mini-split installation, heat pump repair and installation, fireplace installation, thermostat repair, and duct cleaning to homeowners across the region.

Phone: (548) 901-0930  |  Email: contact@parisheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://parisheatingcooling.ca

Service areas: Paris, Brantford, Caledonia, Dunnville, Simcoe, Port Dover, Nanticoke, Ayr, Aylmer
